runs.description: One row per submitted Slay the Spire 2 run. Aggregate this table to count runs, wins, abandons, characters, game modes, and run-level outcomes.

run_id.description: Stable local primary key: the SHA-256 hash of the raw exported run line. Join child run tables to this column.

character.description: Bare character ID from the first player in the run. It contains official and many modded IDs, so treat it as an open set rather than a fixed enum.

was_abandoned.description: Whether the player abandoned the run. A death is win = 0 and was_abandoned = 0.

ascension.description: Ascension difficulty selected for the run.

game_mode.description: Run mode selected by the player.

seed.description: Game seed used to generate the run. It is an opaque text identifier and may be absent.

build_id.description: Game build/version that produced the run, such as v0.109.1.

run_time.description: Recorded run duration in seconds. It may be absent.

start_time.description: Player-local Unix epoch timestamp for when the run started. It may be absent.

submitted_at.description: Approximate ISO-8601 timestamp when the run was submitted, derived from the export cursor. It may be absent.

floors_reached.description: Count of map points visited during the run. It may be absent.

acts.description: Comma-separated act IDs visited during the run. It may be absent.

killed_by_encounter.description: Bare encounter ID that killed the player, or NULL when no encounter caused the loss.

killed_by_event.description: Event ID that killed the player, or NULL when no event caused the loss.

schema_version.description: Version of the submitted run JSON schema. Observed exports use versions 6 through 11.

is_beta.description: Whether the run used a beta build.

run_cards.description: One row per physical card copy in a run's final deck. A card can appear multiple times in the same run.

run_id.description: Run that owns this final-deck card copy.

card_id.description: Bare card reference ID for this copy.

upgrade_level.description: Number of upgrades applied to this physical card copy; zero means unupgraded.

floor_added.description: Floor on which this copy was added to the deck, or NULL when the source did not record it.

joins.description: Connect each final-deck card copy to its run.
Connect each final-deck card copy to card reference metadata.

run_relics.description: One row per relic acquired during a run.

relic_id.description: Bare relic reference ID for the acquired relic.

floor_added.description: Floor on which the relic was acquired, or NULL when the source did not record it.

joins.description: Connect each acquired relic to its run.
Connect each acquired relic to relic reference metadata.

run_card_choices.description: One row per card offered to a player. Use this table to compare offered cards with cards that were picked.

run_id.description: Run in which the card offer appeared.

act.description: One-based act number containing the card offer.

floor_index.description: One-based floor number within the act containing the card offer.

card_id.description: Bare card reference ID for one offered card candidate.

was_picked.description: Whether this offered card candidate was selected.

joins.description: Connect each card offer to its run.
Connect each offered card candidate to card reference metadata.

cards.description: One row per card reference entity from the game export. Join to final-deck cards and offered-card choices for card-level analysis.

card_id.description: Bare card reference ID, such as STRIKE_SILENT.

description.description: Card rules text with source markup removed; it may be NULL.

cost.description: Printed energy cost, or NULL for X-cost cards and some statuses.

is_x_cost.description: Whether the card has a variable X energy cost.

rarity.description: Rarity or special acquisition category of the card.

color.description: Character or special card pool. Modded characters add additional color values.

target.description: Targeting rule used by the card.

keywords.description: Comma-separated card keywords, or NULL when the card has none. Split on commas before matching individual keywords.

relics.description: One row per relic reference entity from the game export. Join to acquired relics for relic-level analysis.

description.description: Relic rules text with source markup removed; it may be NULL.

pool.description: Relic pool used for acquisition. Pools include shared and character-specific pools, including modded character pools.
